We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication.</p> <p>Our Quant Insights team <a href="https://baymard.com/blog/quantitative-insights-launch">conducts recurring studies</a> examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area.</p> <p>This means the role combines <strong>variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology</strong>. You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves <strong>repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process</strong>.</p> <p>At the same time, <strong>the process itself is not fixed</strong>.</p> <p>Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve.
